main_text.p: deficit à doctrina Christi, ut cum matrimonium prohibet, & distinctionem ciborum jubet: quæ duo [illegible, ~6 letters] sic in Papam quadrant, ut utraque putares esse vera, aut utraque putares esse falsa: verum de Antichristo hactenus dictum satis. Unum tamen vereor, nedum operam navo diruendo Papæ imperio, malè consulam rebus Ecclesiarum reformatarum: cum enim videam Reipublicæ Batavorum firmissimo propugnaculo Religionis reformatæ excidium & ruinam intentari à Potentissimo Rege, tum agmina Jesuitarum, missionariorum & Papæ emissariorum in dies in Angliam clam confluere, atque in familias nobiliores irrepere, tum se in consilia regni sanctiora insinuare, non difficile est ariolari

page.notes: The Greek superscript after "duo" is small and not legible enough to read letter by letter. The "170" at top right looks like a faint, possibly handwritten numeral, so it is given as the page number with some doubt. "navo" and "sanctiora" are copied as printed. The page ends with the printed word "lari" completing "ariolari" across the line end, with no catchword.
